title: Sharp improved Sobolev inequalities on $\mathbb{S}^n$
summary: We prove sharp improved Sobolev inequalities on $\mathbb{S}^n$, $n\ge 4$, for functions whose critical density $|u|^{2n/(n-2)}$ has zero barycenter, without any symmetry assumption. The Dirichlet coefficient improves by the optimal factor $2^{-2/n}$, while the coefficient of the $L^2$ term remains one. Equality holds precisely for constant functions. This establishes the sharp form of Aubin's improved Sobolev inequality in every dimension $n\ge4$.
